lines: Good morning. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Sombre Remembrance Day in Wainwright as town honours soldiers killed in military training fire, The Canadian Press reports.
Mississippi elects Democrat Scott Colom as state’s first Black US senator since Reconstruction, The Associated Press reports.
Nvidia’s board is meeting Wednesday evening to discuss CEO Jensen Huang’s future as its leader, two sources familiar with the matter told CNN.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
